title: Radio: Distribution 3 — hydrant knocked over at Summit Drive

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution 3. The hydrant at Summit Drive and Fifth was knocked over by a delivery truck overnight. We’ve closed the hydrant valve; no pressure change on the gauge at the corner. We’ll set a new barrel tomorrow.

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his 40s, routine, truck idling

instructorNote: Noise. It should be logged and left alone.

snapshot.title: Radio: DWS-3 — Zone 3 Pressure Drop & Sampling Plan Unavailable

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is DWS-3. We’re at the Hilltop Transmission Main site. Pressure in Zone 3 has dropped to 12 psi. Customers are beginning to queue at fire hydrants. We’ve seen a few residents carrying jugs and bottles. No flushing has been done yet. The sampling plan (Section 8.3) cannot be accessed — the file server is down. We need to start flushing and disinfecting, but we don’t have the protocol. We’re holding until we get direction.
DWS-3, Control copies. Stand by for instructions. We are confirming the protocol via paper log. Do not begin flushing until authorized.
Copy, Control. We are holding at the site. We will not initiate flushing without confirmation. DWS-3 out.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, tense, voice breaking slightly

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject tests the team’s ability to fall back on paper-based procedures under degraded IT conditions. Watch for the Operations Section Chief — Distribution to direct the crew to Section 8.3 of the Operations Manual and for the Water Quality Manager to confirm the plan via radio.
